description: The startup, which makes autonomous cleaning robots, is backed by pi Ventures and Crane Venture Partners.

title: Fractal Analytics net profit more than doubles to Rs 79 Cr in Q2
description: Consolidated revenue from operations grew by 19.7% to Rs 956.5 crore during the reported quarter from Rs 798.5 crore in the September 2025 quarter.

title: Awfis Q2 profit jumps 93% to Rs 31 Cr, revenue rises to Rs 464 Cr
description: During April-September period of FY27, the company's net profit rose to Rs 54.76 crore from Rs 25.95 crore in the year-ago period.

title: Canva job cuts affect over 1,200 employees as it restructures for AI era
description: Chief executive officer Melanie Perkins said the restructuring followed the company’s first slowdown in growth in a decade and reflected the need to rethink how it operates and organises its teams.

title: EloElo Group raises $80M in Series C led by Hornbill Capital and NBCUniversal
description: EloElo group will use this funding round to launch original content across local languages, foray into international markets and developing AI platforms.

title: ShareChat parent Mohalla Tech records 40% rise in revenue for FY26
description: The company attributed the growth to its micro-drama business, which contributed Rs 293 crore in subscription revenue in its first full year. Mohalla Tech also reported narrowing EBITDA losses by 58% in FY26 and expects to turn EBITDA-positive for the full year in FY27.

title: Indian startups with over $500M valuation grow to 51 despite low number of AI entities: Report
description: The combined value of these 51 entities is about Rs 3.3 lakh crore ($34.1 billion), with an average valuation of about Rs 6,400 crore, and they employ over 60,000 people.

title: Freshworks posts $18.3M net profit in Q3 of 2026
description: Nasdaq-listed Freshworks reported a 14% year-on-year growth in Q3 2026 revenue to $245.4 million. The SaaS company also crossed $1 billion in ARR ahead of its year-end target.

title: Startup news and updates: daily roundup (November 4, 2026)
description: YourStory presents the daily news roundup from the Indian startup ecosystem and beyond. Here’s the roundup for Wednesday, November 4, 2026.
